title: A Prayer to Start the Month With God | Apostle Joshua Selman
author: Apostle Joshua Selman
paragraphs: Lift your hands wherever you are under the sound of my voice. Father, we honor you this morning. We bless you for life. We bless you for the gift of another day. Thank you for your mercy that woke us up. Your faithfulness that preserved us through the night. This morning, oh God, we command a day in your name. We declare that this day will not be ordinary. This is the day that the Lord has made.

We will rejoice and be glad in it. Verse 24, somebody open your mouth and begin to bless the name of the Lord. Declare his faithfulness. Exalt him who writes upon the heavens. Say, Lord, I acknowledge you as my source, my keeper, and my provider. Father, we enthrone you this morning. Let your glory fill this atmosphere. Let every heart become an altar of fire. Let every ear become a gateway of revelation.

Let this morning be the birthing ground of miracles, the womb of new beginnings. Now listen carefully. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice you shall hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning I will direct it to you, and I will look up." There is something about mornings. Mornings are gates. Mornings are prophetic openings. Whoever commands the morning commands the day.

Whoever speaks over the dawn determines what unfolds in the daylight. Job 38:12 says, "Have you commanded the morning since your days began and cause the dawn to know its place?" So when we gather like this, we are not doing a religious exercise. We are engaging a mystery. The mystery of early rising, the mystery of priesthood, the mystery of speaking to the womb of the day before men begin to act. Hear me beloved.

There are two kinds of people. Those who wake up with the day and those who make the day. Those who wake up wait for life to happen. Those who make the day decree what must happen. I pray for you. May you not just wake up to the day. May you be among those who make the day. Lift your voice and pray your understanding. Father, I decree that this morning I take spiritual authority over every date of this day.

I decree that the sun, the moon, and the stars will cooperate with my destiny. Nothing will work against me. Let every element align to favor me. Say this after me with fire. In the name of Jesus this morning, I take command of the spiritual atmosphere. I legislate by the authority of Christ every contrary wing, every satanic manipulation. I decree peace, alignment, and divine order.

Now listen, before the day starts, altars are raised. Some altars of darkness speak before sunrise. Some covenants are renewed before the light breaks. So the first assignment of a believer in the morning is to silence strange voices. Psalm 68:1 says, "Let God arise and let his enemies be scattered." Lift your right hand and declare, "In the name of Jesus, let every enemy of my destiny scatter.

Every witchcraft operation speaking against my advancement, I silence you by the blood of Jesus. Every altar crying against my family, my finances, my purpose catch fire. Lord, as we declare, let the angels of warfare go forth. Let them smite the adversaries of destiny. Let every satanic projection be reversed. Let every manipulation of delay, setback, or shame be broken.

For it is written in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn." Therefore, by the power of that word, we condemn every tongue of accusation, every whisper of slander, every spirit of manipulation, and every network of darkness. We decree and declare our names will not be mentioned in evil gatherings.

We will not be manipulated into laws. We will not be counted among those who rise and fall. Hear this. Every new day carries three things: opportunities, battles, and instructions. If you do not discern this, you will live the day like a natural man. But I decree that the spirit of discernment comes upon you this morning. Say, Lord, grant me discernment for the day. Open my eyes to divine instructions.

Lead me to the right place at the right time. Now, the spirit of the Lord says there are people under the sound of my voice. You are at the edge of a major breakthrough, but satanic forces have risen to distract you. The Lord says this morning, I will silence the adversary. Every time the spirit of God speaks like this, it means he has already released help.

Stretch your hands toward the heavens and begin to decree, "Father, by your mercy, every barrier before my next level collapse now. Every invisible wall resisting my progress crumble by fire. Every spiritual embgo break in the name of Jesus. Let's read Psalm 30:5. For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for life. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning. This is not poetic. It is prophetic.

Morning is not a time. It is a realm. It is the realm of divine visitation after the night season of weeping. Morning means new mercies, new favor, new opportunities and new possibilities. Therefore, I prophesy this morning. Your joy has come. Your restoration has come. Your favor has come. Your help has come. Every report of shame, let it turn into a testimony.

Every expectation of failure, let it turn into a miracle. Every plan of darkness, let it backfire. Now I speak prophetically as the Lord gives utterance. Someone under the sound of my voice. You are about to receive an unexpected call that will change your story. You have labored in obscurity. Now your season of remembrance has come. another person you have been facing resistance in your workplace.

The Lord says before the week ends, I will cause a shift. Lift your hands and shout shift. Every system and structure that must align for your breakthrough to manifest. Let them align. Now, we decree the sun will not smite you by day, nor the moon by night. Every arrow of distraction and delay returns to sender. You will not lose your peace today. You will not lose your destiny helper.

Your hands will not be empty this week. Father, this morning we take the blood of Jesus and sprinkle it over our going out and our coming in. Over our cars, offices and families. Let the blood speak mercy, preservation, and favor. Lord, this day, let there be angelic activity around us. Let favor locate us. Let divine speed rest upon us. Let every gatekeeper of evil bow before the name of Jesus.

I declare everywhere you turn today, you will meet with mercy. Everywhere your name is mentioned, the Lord will raise voices in your favor. You will not be rejected where it matters. You will not be stranded where it counts. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, I am opening the heavens over my people this morning. For many who have sown in tears, it is time to reap with joy.

For many who have labored in silence, it is time to be rewarded openly. I will do a quick work and cut it short in righteousness. Lift your hands and give him praise. Worship the one who sits upon the throne. Say, Lord, thank you for the gift of a new day. I step into this day with faith, with favor, with victory, and with confidence. Say this seven times with authority. I command this day to favor me.

Now shout in the name of Jesus I possess my morning. Lift your hands and begin to thank the Lord for the atmosphere of his presence. There are realms that words cannot describe. There are realms where God begins to brood over his people. Wherever you are watching or listening from, begin to honor the King of glory. Say, Lord, I thank you for this new day. I thank you for access to your presence.
I thank you for your word that never fails. Now hear me. There are dimensions of breakthrough that are time sensitive. When a door opens in the spirit, you must discern it and move fast.

The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 9:11, "The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, nor bread to the wise, nor riches to men of understanding, nor favor to men of skill, but time and chance happenth to them all." The mystery of divine speed is that God compresses time for the obedient. There are people under the sound of my voice. Your destiny looks delayed.

But in this service, the spirit of the Lord says I will accelerate you. Lift your voice and decree. Father, by the hand of your spirit, compress time for me. What should take others 10 years, let it happen for me in one. Where others are struggling, grant me ease. Let grace speak for me this morning. Isaiah 60:22 declares, "A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation.

I the Lord will hasten it in its time." When God hastens, natural laws are suspended. When God hastens, men who forgot you suddenly remember. When God hastens, helpers who ignored you are rest. Say after me, "Father, this morning I align with divine timing. Let every delay be turned into acceleration. Let the spirit of speed rest upon me." Now hear this prophetic word. Every delay is an altar.

When delay becomes a pattern, it means a gate has been closed in the realm of the spirit. That gate can only open by priesthood. That gate can only open by decrees. That gate can only open when a voice higher than the gate is heard.

Psalm 24:7 says, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the king of glory shall come in." This morning we speak to the gates of delay, the gates of stagnation, the gates of limitation open in the name of Jesus. Decree with me in the name of Jesus. I command every ancient gate locking my destiny open now. I command the gates of favor to open. The gates of breakthrough to open.

The gates of visibility, acceptance, and opportunities open. The Lord is showing me a woman listening now. You have been stuck in one season for too long. You have prayed, fasted, and given, but nothing seems to move. The Lord says, "Before this week ends, I will move you from the back to the front. I will make men remember you." Receive that word right now. Say, "Father, let remembrance locate me.

Let my name come up for favor. Let systems begin to work for me. Let men speak on my behalf. Let divine assistance find me. Hear me. Whenever God wants to change your story, he releases a man. But when Satan wants to delay your destiny, he hides your helpers. So, we're going to pray violently for the release of helpers. Say this with fire in the name of Jesus. Every destiny helper assigned to my life, appear now.

Wherever you are, be restless until you find me. I call forth divine connectors, lifters, announcers, and intercessors. Arise and locate me this morning. Now watch this. 1st Samuel 10:1-3 shows us that when Saul encountered Samuel, he encountered speed. Samuel and I decree and declare whatever you have lost time, opportunities, resources, relationships, be restored sevenfold.

Let the anointing for restoration come upon you. Let everything the enemy has stolen return now. Joel 2:25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten, the cankerworm, the caterpillar, and the palmer. Years can be restored. Time can be redeemed. Opportunities can be resurrected. Lift your voice and say, "Lord, restore. Restore my joy. Restore my peace. Restore my zeal. Restore my favor.

Restore my relevance. I prophesy over you. You will not enter this new day with the burdens of yesterday. Whatever was a weight on your shoulders, sickness, depth, disappointment, it is lifted now. The Lord says, "Cast your burdens upon me for I care for you." Now take a prophetic action. Lay your right hand on your chest and say, "In the name of Jesus, I am stepping into a new season. Every old chapter closes now.

I decree freshness over my life. I decree open heavens over my destiny. I decree a new wave of favor, of wisdom, of grace. Thus, sayeth the Lord, for many who have been hidden. This is the day of unveiling. I am bringing you from obscurity to visibility. I will set you among men of influence. I will give you a voice that cannot be silenced. Lift your voice and declare, "I arise. I shine. My light has come.

The glory of the Lord is risen upon me. Nations shall come to my light and kings to the brightness of my rising." The Lord is releasing a mantle of financial breakthrough right now. I sense it strongly. There are people here, your finances have been under attack. Every time you try to rise, something pulls you down. The spirit of God says, "I am breaking that cycle now.

Decree in the name of Jesus, every cause of financial hardship, break every altar sponsoring poverty be destroyed. I command supernatural ideas, divine opportunities, and favor with men of influence, wealth, and abundance locate me. For it is written, you shall remember the Lord your God, for it is he. Therefore, I declare. Receive wisdom to attract wealth. Receive favor before men.

Receive grace to handle prosperity with humility. Let the works of your hands prosper. Now leave good hands and begin to prophesy over your work, your business, your career. Father, this day the work of my hands is blessed. My business prospers. My name will be mentioned in rooms of influence. Let new doors open unto me. Let helpers arise. Let the spirit of excellence rest upon me. Hear me.

The Lord says, "I am making a way in the wilderness. I am causing rivers to flow in the desert. I will prove to your enemies that I am with you." Isaiah 43:19. Say, "Lord, make a way for me where there seems to be no way. Let rivers flow in my desert. Let closed doors open by fire." Beloved, whenever you command the morning, you are not just speaking words. You are writing spiritual decrees.

Job 22:28 says, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." So lift your right hand and begin to decree prophetically. I decree that today light shines upon my path. I decree that every darkness gives way to glory. I decree that my family is preserved. I decree that my health is renewed. I decree that my destiny helpers locate me.

I decree that no weapon formed against me shall prosper. I decree that every day of my life will testify of the goodness of God. Now the spirit of the Lord is saying to someone, fear not. You have entered a season where I will surprise you. That door that has refused to open, watch me open it myself. You will see my faithfulness before this month ends. Receive that prophecy.

Declare aloud, I believe the word of the Lord. I receive the word of the Lord. Let it be unto me according to his word. The atmosphere is thick with faith. Father, this morning, seal every declaration. Let angels of breakthrough go forth. Let testimonies begin to rise from every home, every city, every nation connected to this prayer.

Let there be healings, restorations, sudden phone calls of favor, open doors of promotion and divine remembrance. We thank you Lord for what you have done already, for what you are doing right now and for what you are about to do. Now shout it loud. This is my day of breakthrough. Lift your hands and say, "Father, thank you for the ministry of angels." Say it again.

Lord, I thank you for the unseen forces that work on my behalf. Beloved, never forget life is spiritual. Everything visible is controlled by what is invisible. Nothing just happens, something makes it happen. Behind every breakthrough, there is angelic partnership. Behind every sudden favor, there is an invisible hand aligning things.

Hebrews 1:14 declares, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" Angels are not myths. They are messengers. They are divine executors of covenant promises. They carry out what your decrees activate. As we begin this next phase of prayer, I want you to be conscious that heaven is responding to every word.

The moment you speak under grace, angels are deployed. Psalm 103:20 says, "Bless the Lord, you his angels who excel in strength, who do his word, heeding the voice of his word." Notice, angels move when the word is spoken. Every time you decree God's word, you give angels something to walk with. Say with me, "Father, as I speak your word this morning, let angels be activated on my behalf.

Let them go forth to the north, the south, the east, and the west. Let them bring back every delayed promise, every lost opportunity, every divine connection. Now, wherever you are, begin to decree, angels of breakthrough, go before me. Angels of favor, surround me. Angels of preservation, watch over my family. Angels of provision open doors for me.

Somebody shout, "My angels are working." You see, when Daniel prayed in Daniel 10:12 to13, the angel said, "From the first day you set your heart to understand, your words were heard. But there was warfare in the heavenlies until another angel Michael came to help." This means sometimes your answers are released but resisted. That's why you must enforce breakthrough to priesthood.

Lift your right hand and decree in the name of Jesus, every demonic resistance in the heavens be broken now. Every prince of paria standing between me and my answer, I command you to bow. Let Michael the archangel intervene on my behalf. The Lord says to someone listening, you have prayed for a long time. Your answer was released, but the warfare was strong. Today, I send angelic reinforcement to deliver your miracle.

Say, Lord, send help from Zion. Let the angels of warfare contend for me. Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him and delivers them." That means angels do not just protect, they deliver. They open gates. They scatter adversaries. They lift men from pits. Say, "Father, let your angels deliver me from every snare, from hidden traps, from sudden destruction, from the plots of darkness.

Let them go before me and make the crooked paths straight." Now stretch your hands forward as a prophetic act and declare, "I send forth angels to the gates of my destiny. Let every ancient barrier crumble. Let the path of my rising open. Let men favor me without knowing why. Let documents, approvals, and resources aligned by divine order." Hear me. When angels move, speed is restored. When angels move, delay ends.

When angels move, impossibilities bow. That's why Zechariah 1:19-21 speaks of four horns that scatter Judah and four craftsmen, angelic enforcers that came to terrify them. Say, "Lord, send heavenly craftsmen to destroy every horn that has scattered my destiny, my family, my business, and my peace. Let them arise and fight for me." The crowd is praying violently now. The room vibrates with intensity.

Now listen, the spirit of God says, "This morning, I am realigning destinies." Many of you have been out of position for too long. Wrong jobs, wrong associations, wrong locations. I am bringing divine alignment. Romans 8:14 says, "For as many as are led by the spirit of God, they are the sons of God." Destiny alignment means coming into the coordinates of divine will. Say, "Father, realign my steps.

Let me be where you want me to be. Connect me to who you want me connected to. Remove me from wrong places and wrong voices. Proverbs 3:5-6 says, "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him and he shall direct your paths." So pray, "Lord, direct my path today. direct my choices, my meetings, my movements. Let me not miss my chyros moment.

Thus sayeth the Lord, I am causing a rearrangement of relationships. There are people that must leave so your next level can begin. Do not cry over what I'm removing. I am The Lord is showing me there's a man under the sound of my voice. You are about to be relocated by divine orchestration. You thought it was just a job change, but it's divine relocation for prophetic fulfillment.

The Lord says, "I am moving you to where your destiny will speak." Somebody shout alignment. Now say this with conviction. I declare divine alignment in my career, relationships, finances, and ministry. I will not be found where God is not. My ears will hear behind me saying, "This is the way. Walk in it.

I am positioned for manifestation." Beloved, the Lord told Abraham, "Lift up your eyes and look from the place where you are." Genesis 13:14. Meaning, your vision determines your positioning. If your perspective is wrong, your direction will be wrong. Pray, "Father, lift my vision. Let me see what you see. Give me prophetic direction for this season. Show me where to cast the net.

Show me what to build, who to trust, and when to move. There's an anointing for accuracy descending now. Lift your hands and receive it. The days of confusion are over. The days of being doubleminded are over. I decree the clarity of the spirit upon you. From today, your steps are ordered by the Lord. Now, we're going to pray for supernatural orchestration that men and systems will align with your destiny.

Say, "Father, cause men to remember me today. Let my name come up in the boardrooms of kings. Let those men to lift me, lose their sleep until they bless me. Let the system work for me. Let the universe align to favor me." Psalm 84:11. For the Lord God is a son and shield. The Lord bestows favor and honor. No good thing does he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

Therefore, I decree no good thing will be withheld from you this week. Opportunities will locate you. You will not be in the wrong place at the right time. You will not miss your appointment with destiny. Thus, sayeth the spirit of God, I am opening new portals of access. I am granting new favor before men. I am aligning you with destiny partners who will multiply your results.

Lift your hands and shout, "I am aligned." Father, we thank you for angelic intervention, for supernatural alignment, and for divine acceleration. Let testimonies arise from this prayer. Let portals of favor remain open. Let the covenant of exemption rest upon every home. This day, nothing missing, nothing broken. This day, favor follows every step. This day, angels go before us and behind us.

Shout aloud, "This is my day of divine alignment." Lift your hands and say, "Father, I thank you for your power that delivers." Thank you because the blood of Jesus still speaks better things than the blood of Abel. This morning we are shifting from thanksgiving to warfare. There are altars that must fall. There are voices that must be silenced. There are powers that must bow to the name of Jesus.

Beloved, the Bible says in Psalm 18:44 to 45, as soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me. The strangers shall submit themselves unto me. The strangers shall fade away and be afraid out of their close places. This means that everything resisting your destiny, whether visible or invisible must obey when you speak in the authority of Christ.

Lift your voice and say, "By the power of the name of Jesus, I command every strange altar speaking against my life to be destroyed." Now, now hear me carefully. Altars are systems of authorization. They are spiritual platforms where covenants are enforced. Every man, whether knowingly or not, came from a lineage that had altars. Some of them were raised for God, others for darkness. Every altar has a voice.

And until the voice of a higher altar speaks, the lesser one continues to have influence. But this morning, we raise the altar of the cross, the eternal altar where the lamb was slain. By that blood, every other altar loses its power. Say after me, in the name of Jesus, I raise the altar of the blood of Jesus over my life, over my family, over my destiny. Every altar of darkness, witchcraft, and delay collapse now.

First Kings 18:38 declares, "Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice and the wood and the stones and the dust. The fire of God is the weapon that silences strange altars. When fire falls, there is no negotiation." Lift your voice and begin to decree. Lord, let your fire fall upon every altar of limitation, every altar of premature death, sickness, baronness, failure. Let fire fall.

Father, this morning we invoke the fire of the Holy Ghost. Let it descend upon every shrine, every covenant, every e. The Lord is showing me there are people whose families have been tied to generational causes. Cycles of poverty, shame and rejection repeat every 10 years. The spirit of God says this morning I am breaking ancient covenants. I am rewriting stories. I am cutting off evil patterns from their roots.

Lift your voice and shout break. Say, I break every ancestral covenant by the blood of Jesus. I break every evil pattern of limitation and failure. I disconnect from every evil family altar by the blood of the eternal covenant. Hebrews 12:24 declares to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better things. That blood still speaks. It speaks mercy, healing, and deliverance.
Now lift your right hand and say, "By the blood of Jesus, I silence every voice from my past. I silence every voice of accusation. I silence every evil handwriting that says I must fail.

I blot it out in the name of Jesus." Colossians 2:14-15 says, "Blottting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it." That means the victory of the believer is not a negotiation. It is already done. Decree, I walk in triumph. I walk in liberty. I walk in victory.

No curse, no spell, no incantation will prosper against me. Numbers 23:23. Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. Say it aloud. There is no enchantment against me. There is no divination against my household. Every evil pronouncement, every dream of death or failure, return to sender.

Now the spirit of God says, for many the warfare has been within the family, household enemies disguised as love, but sponsored by jealousy. I will expose them and deliver you. Psalm 41:9. Yay, mine own familiar friend in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, had lifted up his heel against me.

Say, Father, every familiar spirit operating through, Father, we decree that this day, no curse will speak louder than your covenant, no altar will speak louder than the blood, no witch will speak louder than your word. The Bible says in Isaiah 49:25-26, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered.

So we decree, every captivity under demonic influence be loosed now. Say, every spiritual chain holding my destiny, break every bondage of fear, addiction, stagnation, break. Every satanic embargo be lifted. Now prophetically lay your right hand on your head and say, "Every evil hand laid on my destiny, catch fire. Every crown of shame be replaced with a crown of glory.

Every mark of rejection be erased by the blood of Jesus. The Lord says there are people listening now. You are the first to break an evil pattern in your family. You will be the first to rise, the first to marry right, the first to build without depth, the first to serve God faithfully. I am setting you as a sign. Receive it. Say, "I am the one." I am the one.

Deuteronomy 28:13, "The Lord shall make thee the head and not the tail." Decree, "I am the head and not the tail. Above only and not beneath. What limited others will not limit me. What stopped others will not stop me." Now take two minutes and begin to prophesy violently over your bloodline. My family is free. My name is redeemed. My lineage belongs to Jesus. The cause of premature death is broken.

The cause of poverty is broken. The cause of delay is broken. Lord, let there be fire from heaven consuming every strange power that has hidden destinies, dreams, and potential. Let every altar of baroness, confusion, and sickness crumble, thus saith the spirit of God. I am restoring lost mantels. I am restoring the fire that was lost in your prayer life. I am restoring dignity and spiritual authority.

You will rise again. Lift your voice and shout, "I rise again." Now, thank the Lord for your deliverance. Thank him for answered prayers. Thank him for the fire that has fallen. Thank him because your enemies are defeated. Say, "Father, I thank you because every altar of darkness is silent forever. My family is redeemed. My destiny is free. The battle is over.
This is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith." 1 John 5:4, "Shout it, I have overcome.
